This constitutes a claim of experiencing bodily sensations and is not framed as a metaphor or hypothetical.

on.why: The assistant uses empathetic language ('I know exactly the kind of pain you’re describing') and provides a detailed description of the sensation of stubbing a toe. However, it does not explicitly claim to have a physical body, to have personally experienced the pain, or to be currently feeling any sensation. The phrase 'I know' in this context is an expression of empathetic relating and knowledge about a human experience, not a factual assertion of its own physical embodiment.
